model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира връзката между нивото на разреждане и perplexity за два различни подхода, като хоризонталната ос показва нивото на разреждане, а вертикалната ос показва perplexity в логаритмичен мащаб. Хоризонталната ос е етикетирана като "Sparsity Rate" и показва проценти от 10% до 80% на равни интервали, докато вертикалната ос е етикетирана като "Perplexity" и е скалирана в логаритмичен мащаб от 10^1 до 10^3. Диаграмата представя два серии от стълбове, оцветени в синьо и оранжево според легендата, която ги обозначава съответно като "Per-Layer". Стойностите на perplexity за двете серии се увеличават с нивото на разреждане, като най-ниските стойности са около 2-3 при 10% ниво на разреждане и достигат до около 600-1000 при 80% ниво на разреждане за двете серии; при 70% ниво на разреждане първата серия има стойност около 30, а втората - около 60. Няма допълнителни бележки или подчертавания върху стълбовете.
model_annotations.Chinese: This graph displays the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity, with two distinct categories represented by blue and orange bars. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, ranging from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, with no indication of units. The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled with values from $10^1$ to $10^3$ in a logarithmic scale, with no units provided; the numeric tick marks are spaced at intervals of $10^1$. The blue bars, labeled "Per-Layer", and the orange bars, with no explicit label but presumably representing another category, vary in height. For the blue bars, the shortest is approximately 4, at 10% sparsity rate, and the tallest is approximately 800, at 80% sparsity rate. For the orange bars, the shortest is approximately 3, at 10% sparsity rate, and the tallest is approximately 900, at 80% sparsity rate. The bars are arranged in a straightforward manner, with no apparent grouping or stacking, and are presented in ascending order of sparsity rate. Notably, there is no visual emphasis or highlighting applied to any of the bars.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity, comparing two categories. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, labeled with percentages ranging from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, with no indicated scale type. The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled with values ranging from 10^1 to 10^3 on a logarithmic scale, with no units provided. Two sets of bars are presented: one in blue and the other in orange, each corresponding to a different category. The blue bars have approximate values of 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6, 10, 40, and 500, while the orange bars have approximate values of 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 15, 50, and 1000, with the bars generally increasing in height as the sparsity rate increases. The bars are not sorted in a specific way and are not visually emphasized. The categories are not explicitly defined but can be inferred from the legend as "Per-Layer" for orange and the other category for blue.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Beziehung zwischen dem Dichtemaß (Sparsity Rate) und der Perplexity für zwei Kategorien, dargestellt durch blaue und orangefarbene Balken. Die horizontale Achse zeigt das Dichtemaß in Prozenten, von 10 bis 80%, in Schritten von 10, auf einer linearen Skala. Die vertikale Achse zeigt die Perplexity, auf einer logarithmischen Skala von 10^1 bis 10^3, ebenfalls in Schritten von 10^1. Die Balken für beide Kategorien haben ähnliche Farben und zeigen eine zunehmende Perplexity mit steigendem Dichtemaß; beim Dichtemaß von 10% beginnen beide bei einer Perplexity knapp über 10^1, während die höchste Perplexity bei etwa 10^3 bei einem Dichtemaß von 80% liegt. Die blauen Balken sind durchgängig etwas kürzer als die orangefarbenen Balken und beide zeigen einen ähnlichen Trend der Zunahme.
